variant_desc: Open-addressed hash table with noinline strong hash (12 keys) -> 12-pair flat linear scan; 1e6 lookups, 100% hit rate (variant 4: seed=46, n_scale=0.7x)
novelty_rationale: Tests cardinality-aware data-structure selection: a 12-entry dictionary should be a flat linear scan (2 cache lines, predictable branches, no hashing cost), not an std::unordered_map / HashMap with a strong hash function. Compilers cannot reason about input cardinality, so they will never replace a hash-table lookup with a linear scan based on N.
